synth.notes:
Mechanics: 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks, x=row; one horizontal axis row A + holed pieces; A1/A2 move selection up/down, A3/A4 move pieces left/right (axis ignores), bounds + no piece overlap.
Reflections: each piece block b!=A -> row 2A-b, clipped, skipped on piece blocks; layers wall<target<reflection<piece, holes transparent (selected fill 0, reflection fill 4), then re-extract.
Names: wall/player = 4-conn comps of own cells + all 0 cells ranked by bbox (0-only comps counted, not output); reflections own comps; targets per sprite by visible bbox.
Step-64 fix: A5 cycle axis -> pieces in identity order (size desc = L 7 blocks before T 6, tie min block) -> axis; current-rank order fails only step 64. No visible 0 -> selected = piece whose hole centres all show other objects.
Unconfirmed: size-desc is a proxy for the game's internal piece order (only 2 pieces seen). Passes 33/33 stateless too; hidden state only continuity-gated model reuse.
